description: Version drift between the shared packages and their consumers is the risk PRD §15 names, and it has already happened once (the template sat on @abeon/sdk-ts v0.5.0 while v0.6.0 was tagged).

packageRules.description: The platform's own packages, installed from git tags. Raised immediately and on their own, because a consumer left behind is the failure this exists to catch.
Everything else arrives as one weekly pull request.
